additional_info.subject: RE: ID0433711-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002730] Charging sessions unsuccessful CRM:02832000130
additional_info.body:
Hello
Giuseppe Buffardi,
I hope this message finds you well.
Based on the logs, it was observed that the charging sessions were initiated on DC1 (Connector id-1), but the remote transactions were on the AC outlet (Connector id-2). Therefore, the charging process were unsuccessful.
Additionally, I checked the logs for connector-1 and observed that in the last year, there was no charging session performed except 26/06.
If possible, could you please confirm the Commissiong date of this charger and also please share the commissioning report with us so that we can find the root cause of the issue.
If you have any further queries, please let us know.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
